articles.title: Getting started with Mantis, our open-source bug finding-and-fixing harness
articles.summary: Google's open-source framework for automated vulnerability discovery and patching.
articles.detail: Mantis is a new open-source tool that automates the process of finding and fixing software vulnerabilities. It can help defenders gain an advantage over attackers by discovering vulnerabilities before they do.

articles.title: Simplify pipelines with new BigQuery identity columns
articles.summary: BigQuery now supports auto-generated sequential IDs, simplifying data ingestion and management.
articles.detail: The new feature allows users to define columns that automatically generate sequential 64-bit integer values, making it easier to manage unique identifiers within tables.

articles.title: Introducing TabFM in BigQuery: Predictive analytics reimagined
articles.summary: BigQuery now offers a new predictive analytics feature that simplifies the process of building and deploying models.
articles.detail: TabFM is a new feature that allows users to build predictive models without requiring extensive machine learning expertise. It can help speed up the deployment of AI-powered applications.

articles.title: Financially Motivated Threat Actor BREEZE COMET Targets Brazil
articles.summary: Google's Threat Intelligence Group has identified a new threat actor targeting financial institutions in Brazil.
articles.detail: BREEZE COMET is a financially motivated threat actor that specializes in manipulating payment systems and banking software in Brazil. The group has been active since 2024.

articles.title: Reduce Traffic Interruptions with Gateway Load Balancer TCP Reset
articles.summary: AWS has introduced a new feature that reduces traffic interruptions caused by firewall or security appliance failures.
articles.detail: The Gateway Load Balancer TCP Reset feature helps to minimize the impact of failures on mission-critical applications by quickly resetting TCP connections.

articles.title: Implementing encryption in transit across connectivity patterns with VPC Encryption Controls
articles.summary: AWS has introduced a new feature that enables customers to enforce encryption in transit across all network paths.
articles.detail: VPC Encryption Controls provide a centralized way to manage encryption policies across multiple accounts and regions, helping to improve security and compliance.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
articles.summary: Azure Front Door now supports profile and route level WAF policy associations in public preview.
articles.detail: The new feature provides more flexibility to apply broad baseline protection across an Azure Front Door profile while using targeted policies for specific routes.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Windows Server 2025 on AKS
articles.summary: AKS now offers GA support for Windows Server 2025, helping customers modernize their workloads.
articles.detail: The new feature provides a more secure and reliable platform for running Windows-based workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

articles.title: An Organizational Second Brain: Building an AI That Learns From Experts
articles.summary: Meta has developed a new AI agent that acts as a secondary expert for a given domain, making deep specialist knowledge readily available.
articles.detail: The AI agent integrates two layers: a structured, auditable knowledge architecture and a machine learning model. It can help preserve and share expertise across an organization.

articles.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
articles.summary: NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a leading AI platform for natural language processing and computer vision.
articles.detail: The acquisition will help scale Hugging Face's platform and expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide.

articles.title: Racing Against Machine-Speed Threats: How Arista Is Using AI
articles.summary: Arista is using AI to improve product security and respond to machine-speed threats.
articles.detail: The company is integrating AI into its products to provide better threat detection and response capabilities.

articles.title: Broadcom Earnings Prediction Market Preview: Will Hock Tan Talk ‘Competition’?
articles.summary: Broadcom is set to report earnings, with analysts predicting a strong quarter.
articles.detail: The company's performance will be closely watched by investors and industry observers.

articles.title: Amazon Stock Could Surprise Investors Over the Next 12 Months
articles.summary: AWS has posted its fastest growth in 18 quarters, driving Amazon's stock performance.
articles.detail: The company's investments in AI and infrastructure are expected to continue driving growth.

articles.title: Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched a new solution that combines privacy and safeguards for detecting misuse.
articles.detail: The Enterprise Frontier Safeguards solution uses zero data retention and state-of-the-art safeguards to protect customer data.
